messages:
Priyanka Singh: Hey team, excited to join! My laptop and dock arrived, but the external monitor didn't. Tracker says 'delivered' though. Also when I plug the dock in the laptop charges but the monitor says 'No Input'. Who should I ping for a missing delivery and quick dock checks? :wave:

IT - Carlos: Welcome Priyanka! Two separate things: 1) delivery - ping Logistics, 2) monitor detection - quick checklist: swap the video cable, try the other video port on the dock, and if mac, System Settings > Displays > Option-click Detect Displays. Can you tell me the monitor model and the tracking number?

Priyanka Singh: Monitor is a ViewSonic VA2719, tracking on the onboarding page shows RDW-774200 marked delivered yesterday at 16:32 but no door tag.

Logistics Bot: Update for RDW-774200: status=delivered, delivery_time=2025-12-03 16:32 PST, courier=ShipFast, location=Left at reception. Proof_of_delivery=photo_available.

Priyanka Singh: Hmm I checked reception and they don't have it. Could the building concierge have taken it?

People Ops - Mei: @Priyanka sorry about that. Sam in Logistics can check the POD photo and confirm who signed/received. Sam?

Sam (Logistics): Looking now. The POD photo shows package at a lobby bench with a person partially visible but no signature. I'll contact the courier and request GPS drop coordinates + driver notes. If you need a monitor today, Facilities can lend a spare. @Omar?

Facilities - Omar: I can swing by with a spare in ~30 mins and leave it at your desk. If it's a border-case we can mark the original as 'missing' once courier confirms.

IT - Carlos: For the 'No Input' issue: try a different USB-C cable if you have one (some cables are power-only). Also try connecting the monitor directly to the Mac with monitor's USB-C (alt-mode) if available. If it still doesn't detect, collect output of `system_profiler SPDisplaysDataType` or on Windows check Display Settings > Detect.

Priyanka Singh: I tried my personal USB-C cable and monitor briefly showed the external screen for like 2 seconds then reverted. System profiler shows only the built-in display: `Display VendorID: 610 DisplayProductID: 820`.

IT - Carlos: That points to intermittent enumeration from the dock. Could be a cable or dock port. @Omar if you bring a spare, can also bring a spare dock to swap and rule that out. Priyanka, please open an IT ticket with subject "Monitor not detected / possible dock" so we capture serials.

Sam (Logistics): Courier replied: driver notes say delivered to "front desk - package left on bench" and GPS coordinates match building entrance. They're escalating to local depot for a trace. I set the package status to "under investigation" and started a claim. ETA for claim update: 24-48 hrs.

Priyanka Singh: Thanks Sam. I'll grab the spare for now. Opening ticket. Ticket #IT-21567 created.

Facilities - Omar: At desk in ~25 mins with a ViewSonic spare and a spare dock. Carlos, want me to meet you at 10B to swap?

IT - Carlos: Yes please, meet at desk 10B. If swap proves dock is flaky we'll RMA it. Priyanka, keep the spare monitor until Logistics confirms claim outcome.

Priyanka Singh: Great, appreciate everyone's fast help :smile: I'll wait for the spare and keep an eye on the claim. Thanks!
